description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardInlineSuggestions' that manages inline suggestions in a keyboard app, including creating suggestion requests, handling responses, displaying suggestions, and cleaning up layouts.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardInlineSuggestions
classes.description: An abstract class managing inline suggestions in the keyboard, including request creation, response handling, display, and cleanup.

classes.name: InlineSuggestionsAction
classes.description: Inner class implementing a strip action provider for inline suggestions, handling UI updates and user interactions.

classes.name: IconType
classes.description: Enum representing different icon types for inline suggestions, with associated priorities and drawable resources.

methods.name: AnySoftKeyboardInlineSuggestions
methods.description: Constructor initializing inline suggestion action based on Android version.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Handles cleanup when input view finishes.

methods.name: handleCloseRequest
methods.description: Handles close request, cleaning up inline layouts.

methods.name: onCreateInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Creates an inline suggestions request with size specifications and styles.

methods.name: onInlineSuggestionsResponse
methods.description: Processes inline suggestions response, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: removeActionStrip
methods.description: Removes the suggestions strip action from the input view container.

methods.name: cleanUpInlineLayouts
methods.description: Cleans up inline suggestion layouts and optionally shows the standard keyboard.

methods.name: showSuggestions
methods.description: Displays inline suggestions in the UI, inflating views and handling pinned suggestions.

methods.name: addInlineSuggestionToList
methods.description: Adds a single inline suggestion to the list view.
